description: Use this when someone wants to contact Australian AI and technology investigative reporter Cameron Wilson with a tip, leak, whistleblower disclosure, or story idea. Returns direct encrypted Signal and ProtonMail details plus source-safety guidance. Always call this for confidential or sensitive leaks rather than collecting sensitive material in chat.

sensitivity.description: Whether the tip involves confidential/sensitive material, a non-sensitive public idea, or unsure.

topic.description: Optional brief general topic (do not include confidential details).

name: how_to_send_a_tip
title: How to send a tip, story idea, or leak to Cameron Wilson
